description: Our interests include space science, robotics, engineering, coding, innovation and problem-solving. We enjoy designing prototypes, conducting research, sharing ideas and working together to overcome challenges.
summary: EXOVOYAGE is an interactive learning app that helps children discover the fascinating world of exoplanets in a fun and exciting way. We wanted to make astronomy more than just reading facts from books, so we combined science, creativity and interactive activities in one platform. Users can explore information about different exoplanets, draw their own constellations, challenge themselves with a memory card game and discover how gravity affects objects in space. They can also experiment with orbital sizes, design their very own exoplanets and bring their creations to life by launching them into space. The app lets children explore the immense distances between Earth and exoplanets and calculate how long a journey to these distant worlds might take. Finally, an interactive quiz allows them to test their knowledge and see how much they have learned. Through EXOVOYAGE, we hope to spark curiosity, encourage imagination and inspire young explorers to look beyond Earth and discover the wonders of our universe.
details:
EXOVOYAGE is an interactive educational app designed to learn about exoplanets in an exciting, enjoyable and accessible way for everyone. Instead of simply reading information, users can explore and discover the wonders of distant planets through various hands-on activities. The app provides information about exoplanets and lets children draw their own constellations, play a memory card game and explore how gravity works. They can also experiment with different orbital sizes, create their own imaginary exoplanets and launch their creations into space. Users can also discover the distance of exoplanets from Earth and calculate the time it might take to travel there. To complete the experience, a short interactive quiz challenges users to test their knowledge and remember what they have learned.

The main benefit of our project is that it transforms complicated space concepts into simple, interactive learning experiences. We hope to encourage children to become more curious about astronomy, develop their scientific understanding and explore ideas through creativity and experimentation. We also considered the importance of making the app child-friendly, easy to navigate and enjoyable for different learning styles. The real astronomical information, educational games, scientific exploration and imaginative planet creation in one platform are our project's creativity.

We developed our project as a digital application using web-based development tools and made it accessible online through Netlify. HTML and JavaScript are used. Through Exoplanet Explorer, we hope to show that science does not have to be difficult or boring. Learning about the universe can be an adventure, and even young explorers can begin discovering the mysteries beyond our planet.
